subject: general
question: Two men start travelling from the same place in the same direction at the rate of 5 km/h and 5.5 km/h respectively. To be 8.5 km apart from each other, the time taken by them is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the one man = 5 km/h 

Speed of the other man = 5.5 km/h

**Formulas used:**

Relative Speed in the same direction = Speed A - Speed B 

Time = Distance/Speed 

**Calculation:**

Relative speed of both men = 5.5 - 5 = 0.5 km/h 

Distance = 8.5 km 

Time = 8.5 km/0.5 km/h 

⇒ 17 hours 

**∴ The required time = 17 hours **
